prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1192; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at a signalized intersection. Our client was struck on the driver's side while proceeding through the intersection, and the resulting injuries are significant and remain under medical evaluation. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office. Do not contact our client directly, by telephone, in writing, or in person, and route any inquiries about the claim through this firm.

We request that you provide a certified copy of the declarations page and the full policy limits for all coverages applicable to the at-fault driver, including bodily injury liability, along with confirmation of any excess or umbrella coverage. Please also confirm in writing the claim number assigned to this loss.

We further demand that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, dash camera and telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, repair and salvage records, recorded statements, claim notes, and all communications with the insured or any witness. Please ensure that no vehicle or component is repaired, altered, or disposed of without prior notice to this office.
